meta.name: gstack-office-hours
meta.description: GStack office-hours method for early product ideas, startup demand checks, builder-mode brainstorming, narrow wedge selection, and pre-architecture clarification before plan review.

copy.tagline: 验证早期产品创意与需求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在探索产品方向或验证市场假设
copy.tagline_en: Validate early product ideas and demand
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are exploring product direction or validating market assumptions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会针对早期产品创意、创业需求验证、头脑风暴等场景，提出关键追问、窄楔子建议、现状记录、假设清单，并推荐下一步要做的工件。
howto.when: 当产品想法还很模糊、用户询问某个想法是否值得做、或架构需要先确认需求时触发。用户也可以直接说“$gstack-office-hours”来调用。

say.text: 我有一个创业点子，帮我用gstack方法验证一下。
say.note: Claude会按流程输出追问和窄楔子建议。

say.text: 这个功能需求是否值得先做？
say.note: Claude会进行需求验证并给出下一步推荐。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will ask forcing questions, suggest a narrow wedge, note status-quo, list assumptions, and recommend next artifact for early product ideas, startup demand checks, builder-mode brainstorming, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a product idea is early or fuzzy, user asks if an idea is worth building, or architecture needs demand reality check. Also triggered by explicit invocation "$gstack-office-hours".

say_en.text: I have a startup idea, validate it using the gstack method.
say_en.note: Claude will output forcing questions and narrow wedge suggestions.

say_en.text: Is this feature worth building first?
say_en.note: Claude will perform demand validation and recommend next steps.

say_en.text: Use gstack-office-hours to analyze my product idea.
